summary: Iteration 7 — verified ALL new Quiz frontend features for the multi-mode (Тест / Верно-неверно / Карточки) iteration. End-to-end Playwright run against the public preview URL with quiz_qa@test.com / Test1234. Login → dismiss email-verify modal → bottom-nav 'Тесты' → import modal opens with 3-mode selector → switching to 'flashcard' correctly changes slider label to 'Количество карточек' and CTA to 'Создать карточки' → .docx upload to /api/quiz/extract-text returns 375 chars of Russian 'Клеточное дыхание' text into the textarea → .pdf upload returns 207 chars of EN Newton's Laws text. Played existing TRUE/FALSE quiz 'Клеточное дыхание' (4 questions) — every question had exactly 2 options labelled 'Верно' / 'Неверно' (testids quiz-option-0 and quiz-option-1), explanation revealed after selection, next-btn advances, final screen shows quiz-results with a quiz-review list of 4 ReviewItems. Played existing FLASHCARD quiz 'Закон Ома' (4 cards) — flashcard front rendered ('Закон Ома (определение)'), tap flipped it to the back ('Сила тока...'), flashcard-know / flashcard-dont-know both advance, after the 4th card results appear with score ring (50%, '2 из 4'), and a 4-item quiz-review listing each card's front/back. Quiz list cards show correct mode badges ('Тест' / 'Верно/неверно' / 'Карточки') and correct count label ('4 карточек' for flashcards, '4 вопросов' / '5 вопросов' for the others). No regressions. No bugs found.

issues: CTA description still says 'Файл .txt или вставь текст — получишь тест с вопросами' but uploads now also accept .pdf and .docx, and generation produces tests OR carts. Minor copy inconsistency only — UX clarity nit.

action_items: OPTIONAL (LOW): Update QuizSection import CTA subtitle to mention .pdf/.docx and the new formats (currently says only .txt + 'тест с вопросами').
OPTIONAL (LOW, unchanged from iter-6): The 'Подтвердите email' reminder modal still appears on every fresh load and must be dismissed before bottom nav is clickable.
critical_code_review_comments: QuizPlayer.jsx ReviewItem (flashcard branch): displays the back as q.answer with no label/hint — fine, but for accessibility a tiny 'Ответ' caption (or icon) would help users scan the review list.

ImportLectureModal.jsx accept attribute on file input is 'accept=".txt,.md,.text,.pdf,.docx,text/plain,application/pdf"' — missing the MIME type for .docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document). The extension-based filter still works because the input also lists the extensions, but adding the docx MIME would be more correct on Safari/iOS file pickers.

QuizPlayer progress bar formula 'animate width = ((index + (locked?1:0)) / total) * 100%' is used only for MCQ/TF — for flashcards the bar effectively never reaches 100% during play because `flipped` isn't part of the formula and the flash-card branch passes `false` to that ternary. Cosmetic only; works because answering immediately advances index.
QuizSection CTA copy 'Файл .txt или вставь текст — получишь тест с вопросами' is stale — doesn't mention .pdf/.docx or the new flashcard/true-false modes.

success_rate.frontend: 100% — every new selector and flow in the review request was exercised and passed

seed_data_creation: No new quizzes generated this iteration. Pre-existing seed quizzes were sufficient: 'Закон Ома' (flashcard, 4 cards), 'Клеточное дыхание' (true_false, 4 questions), 'Фотосинтез' (multiple_choice, 5 questions). All three were used (not deleted) so the next agent can re-run without regenerating via real LLM.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All new Quiz features are working: mode selector, .docx/.pdf server-side extraction into textarea, true_false 2-option player, flashcard flip + know/don't-know advance, results screen with review list. Existing seed quizzes of all 3 modes are present in the DB for quiz_qa@test.com — reuse them to avoid burning LLM credits.
